newsitem.title: CHINA: Standard Oil plans Chinese JVs - Xinhua.
newsitem.headline: Standard Oil plans Chinese JVs - Xinhua.

text.p: Standard Oil Co of the United States, part of British Petroleum Co Plc, is negotiating with Chinese counterparts to set up joint ventures in China's northern port city of Tianjin and southern Guangdong province, the Xinhua news agency said on Wednesday.

The new ventures will produce plastic bottles and storage facilities for liquefied gas and oil products, it quoted Standard Oil vice president Don Voelte as saying in a meeting with Beijing Mayor Li Qiyan.
The U.S. firm has set up an office in Beijing and wants long-term cooperation with Beijing, Voelte said.
The company has already invested more than $90 million in Tianjin and in eastern Jiangsu province, Xinhua said. It gave no other details.
